classification.difficultyReason: Read a linear PDF from a graph, then build the CDF from trapezoid, triangle and rectangle areas. Part b needs a piecewise CDF with carried-over area; there is no sketching or normalising.

content.prompt: Each graph shows a PDF. Use area formulae to find the CDF.

answer.worked:
The line has gradient $-\frac18$, so $f(x)=\dfrac{4-x}{8}$. The area from $0$ to $x$ is a trapezoid with parallel sides $\frac12$ and $\frac{4-x}{8}$ and width $x$.
$$\begin{align*}F(x)&=\frac12\left(\frac12+\frac{4-x}{8}\right)x\\&=\frac12\cdot\frac{8-x}{8}\cdot x\\&=\frac{x(8-x)}{16}\end{align*}$$
Check: $F(4)=1$.

For $0\le x\le2$, the line through the origin and $(2,\frac14)$ is $f(x)=\frac x8$. The area is a triangle with base $x$ and height $\frac x8$.
$$F(x)=\frac12\cdot x\cdot\frac x8=\frac{x^2}{16}.$$
So $F(2)=\frac14$. For $2\le x\le5$, add a rectangle of width $x-2$ and height $\frac14$.
$$\begin{align*}F(x)&=\frac14+\frac14(x-2)\\&=\frac{x-1}{4}\end{align*}$$
Check: $F(5)=1$.
